notes.joints: T x 22 x 3, metres, y-up, HumanML3D/SMPL joint order (see skeleton.json). Recovered with recover_from_ric(feat,22) from raw (already de-normalised) 263-d features. Floored: clip-wide min y = 0. Root trajectory kept, shifted so frame-0 pelvis x=z=0. Initial facing is +z; subject left is +x.
notes.imu: IMUSim IdealIMU on the IK-retargeted BVH (bvh_resized, offsets x1.7/1.55), sampled at 20 Hz, sensor-local frame. acc = specific force in m/s^2 (includes gravity, ~9.8 at rest); gyro in rad/s. T_imu = T-1; sample k aligns with joint frame k. First 1-2 samples contain spline start-up transients.
notes.encoding: b64 = base64 of little-endian int16, value = int * scale, reshape to shape.
notes.selection: GPT-4 motion-filter verdict yes, heuristic sanity checks (length >= 3 s, no teleports, activity-specific pose checks, no IMU spikes: |acc| <= 120 m/s^2 and |gyro| <= 25 rad/s at every site; spikes come from IK orientation flips, mostly at the forearm), prefer T <= 160 frames, then greedy max-min diversity in T2M evaluator motion-embedding space with de-duplicated prompts.
